This '''Neimoidian''' was a [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this individual was stationed on a Separatist [[Unidentified Separatist asteroid base|asteroid base]] and was involved in the development of a [[Updated battle droid|new model]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]].
